^1SULLIVAN: ^7Since Miller's recon mission was a total fubar... 
We're blind from here on out.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_014C_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Jackson's squad will hit the beach just up ahead...
Let's move.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_014B_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Support squad will hit
the beach just up ahead... Let's move!
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_016A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Stay on your toes...  They could be anywhere.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_017A_PHIL: ^1US MARINE: ^7Sarge, you ever see a Banzai charge?
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_020A_PHIL: ^1US MARINE: ^7Some crazy tactic they pull when...
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_023A_PSOU: ^1US MARINE: ^7Shit...  Nearly had a freakin' heart attack.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_023A_PSOU_SAFE: ^1US MARINE: ^7Nearly had a freakin' heart attack.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_026A_PHIL: ^1US MARINE: ^7Looks like a temple or some shit...
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_027A_PSOU: ^1US MARINE: ^7What do the Japanese pray to anyway?
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_029A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Jackson's squad should be there
any minute now...
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_029B_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Support squad should be
there any minute now...
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_033A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Japanese infantry in the river...
Moving in from the west!
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_035A_SULL_E:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Roebuck, MG on the right...
The other one's mine.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_038A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7I want to get through the rest
of this quick and clean.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_042A_SULL_B:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7These bastards are full of surprises...
I don't like surprises.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_042A_SULL_SAFE:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7The Japanese are full of surprises...
I don't like surprises.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_048A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Radio command...
Find out if another unit came in ahead of us.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_051A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Miller, use your knife and put
a hole in that barrel.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_054A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Time ain't on our side! Hit that barrel!
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_520A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Bail out before it hits the camp!
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_206A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Hudson's squad's landing
over there on the right!
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_065B_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller, keep a watch outside.
We don't want any more surprises.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_208A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Damn!...  Timer's fried...
We may only get a few minutes before detonation.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_208A_ROEB_SAFE:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Timer's fried...  We may only
get a few minutes before detonation.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_304A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I need you to cover me
while I plant the charges!
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_209A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller, get to work planting those charges...
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_210A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7The timer got fried in that last fire fight...
We may only get a few minutes before detonation.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_211A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sullivan... We had to jerry-rig the charges!
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_212A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We need to get
to the extraction point ASAP!
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_IGD_080A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7I do not want anyone left behind.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_OUT_002A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7You're gonna be okay, just hang in there.
common.SUBTITLE_MAK1_OUT_105A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sullivan, ever been in a fight like that?
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_004A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Okay... Keep it together and we'll
get through this in three days.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_003A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Navy's been bombin' hell out of the island for two days straight.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_003A_SULL_SAFE: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Navy's been bombin' the island for two days straight.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_007A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Miller! We hit any resistance
on the beach,  you get on that radio and call
for immediate missile support!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_008A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Roebuck, I want you up the beach
and at the treeline asap. 
You're on point as we move inland.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_011A_ROEB_A: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7FUCK! East ridge! There's a 200mm on the point!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_011A_ROEB_SAFE: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7East ridge!... There's a 200mm on the point!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_102A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Everyone!  Keep... your... heads... down!  You hear me?
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_103A_USR2: ^1US MARINE: ^7The Lord is my Shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: He leadeth me beside the still waters. He restoreth my soul: He leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for His name' sake. Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: For thou art with me; Thy rod and thy staff, they comfort me. Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies; Thou annointest my head with oil; My cup runneth over. Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the House of the Lord forever.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_017A_POLO: ^1POLONSKY: ^7We need to get off this thing!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_019A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Driver, drop the ramp!  That gun could zero in on us anytime.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_INT_020A_PSOU: ^1US MARINE: ^7It's the coral.  We're stuck on the...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_300A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7I got you Miller! You're still in one piece!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_301A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Plan's gone to shit... Tojo's got a defensive line dug in just beyond the treeline.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_100A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7We got heavy MG fire tearing up the beach!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_302A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Stay where you are and get ready with that radio.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_101A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Call in rocket strikes
on those positions! NOW!!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_106A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7We need rockets on those MG's ASAP!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_107A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7We're gettin' torn
to shreds here! CALL THOSE ROCKETS!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_201A_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Where are you going?
We need those rockets!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_800A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Barrage -salvo H-E, 
Waco two-five, azimuth 3320, range 2200...
Firing for effect - on the way!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_803A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Salvo barrage, 
Waco two-five effective... target destroyed. 
Check your fire.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_804A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Target miss... 
Diligent one-six adjust your fire!
Repeat, adjust your fire!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_805A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Barrage-salvo H-E, 
Waco eight-one, Azimuth 35, 
Range 28... on the way!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_806A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Airedale Three has your smoke
at Bravo Lima six actual... Ironclad firing for effect... 
On the way!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_807A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Your flare spotted
at grid Able Delta five-niner.
H-E salvo close, in-bound now!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_808A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Adjusting fire your target
Azimuth 33, range 29... H-E salvo close... 
On the way!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_809A_RADO: ^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Registering your target Azimuth 33, range 29... H-E salvo close... on the way!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_814A_RADO: ^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Fire mission unavailable at this time.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_829A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Fire support ready.
State your target.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_833A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Off shore rocket
strike at the ready.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_834A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Rocket strike primed
and ready to fire.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_837A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Airstrike primed
and ready to fire.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_844A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Negative on those
co-ordinates. Check your status.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_000A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Get off the beach the beach!
MOVE!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_003A_SULL: ^1SULLIVAN: ^7Don't let 'em get a fix on you...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_203A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Good work, Marines...
Regroup at the treeline!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_206A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Just get moving!
We'll deal with it later!!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_304A_USR1:
^1US MARINE: ^7There wasn't supposed
to be any resistance!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_307A_USR3: ^1US MARINE: ^7I think his LVT got hit!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_311A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7That rocket strike should
have softened them up.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_018A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Pick it up...
Push through their lines!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_042A_POLO: ^1POLONSKY: ^7They were hiding, just waiting for us...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_044A_ROEB_B: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7From here on out, watch the terrain.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_048A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Get in there...
See if you can get a flanking position.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_050A_ROEB_A: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Let's get the jump on these bastards.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_050A_ROEB_SAFE: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Let's get the jump on these animals.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_210A_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Miller!!  Call a rocket strike
on that MG nest!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_315A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7We need to wipe those
bastards out!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_061A_SULL:
^1SULLIVAN: ^7Get on those MG's
and tear them up!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_IGD_316A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I don't think that MG's
gonna cut it, Miller!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_OUT_202A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sullivan! No... Hold on...
You'll be okay... CORPSMAN!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1_OUT_202B_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sullivan! No... Hold on...
You'll be okay... MEDIC!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_500A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Arrangements are being made
to take his body back to the states.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_501A_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7I thought Sullivan would make
it through for sure.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_502A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We let our guard down, Polonsky.
We can't let it happen again.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_503A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Tojo's got a tight hold on pretty much
everything to the west.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_504A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^75th and 7th Marines are about
to launch their assault on the airfield...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_001B_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Direct route runs right into Japanese guns.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_003B_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We take the flank.
It might get us wet, but it's not going to get us killed. 
We regroup with the 5th when we're through this swamp.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_005A_PGRI: ^1US MARINE: ^7SARGE! We got a downed Corsair.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_006A_POLO_A:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Poor bastard must have been
shot down this morning.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_006A_POLO_SAFE:
^1POLONSKY: ^7He must have been shot down
this morning.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_007A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller, fuselage is still smoking...
Check for survivors.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_007B_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Fuselage is still smoking...
Check for survivors.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_008A_PGRI: ^1US MARINE: ^7He's all snarled up on something...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_014A_POLO_A: ^1POLONSKY: ^7Can't believe they'd booby trap our dead...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_017A_POLO_C:
^1POLONSKY: ^7I think we're kinda late.
Sounds like the 5th's kicking ass.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_017A_POLO_SAFE:
^1POLONSKY: ^7I think we're kinda late.
Sounds like the 5th's already fighting!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_018A_ROEB_A:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7MG's in the bunkers up ahead.
Nambu artillery sittin' right in front of it.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_029A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I want suppressing fire on those MG's!
The flamethrowers need to reach the bunkers.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_200A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller, get the flamethrower and finish the job!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_033A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Keep it together.
Airfield's about half a mile north.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_301A_PFOR:
^1US MARINE: ^7Awww shit...
Bastards just took down another one.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_301A_PFOR_SAFE: ^1US MARINE: ^7They just took down another one!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_302A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7All the more reason to keep pushin'.
Every plane we lose makes our job harder.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_303A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7So, let's pick it up and take out
those damn guns.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_303A_ROEB_SAFE:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7So, let's pick it up and take out
those guns.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_109A_PHIL: ^1US MARINE: ^7Guy in the tree, guy in the tree!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_112A_PHIL: ^1US MARINE: ^7They were just waiting for us...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_041A_PLOG: ^1US MARINE: ^7The 7th came in from the north!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_042A_PGAS:
^1US MARINE: ^7They're trying to get their tanks
on to the airfield, but it's a nightmare over there.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_043A_PLOG:
^1US MARINE: ^7Tojo's holding tight!
We're pinned down by the MG fire
from the second floor.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_048A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller! Load up with those
rifle grenades and blow that damn bird off his perch.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_048A_ROEB_SAFE:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller! Load up with those
rifle grenades and blow that bird off his perch.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_054A_ROEB_A: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7One last push and we take the airfield!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_056A_ROEB_A:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7It never is... But we can do this,
Polonsky, okay?
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_060A_POLO_A:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Japanese AA Guns are zeroed
on our planes!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_061A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We'll get to them!...
We gotta deal with their tanks first!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_063A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Bazookas, rifle grenades!
Hit 'em with whatever you can!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_801A_USR1: ^1US MARINE: ^7Get a bazooka from the trenches!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_071A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Move up and take out the AA Guns!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_073A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Miller!  Take out the first gun crew!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_080A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get the last one,
before we lose anymore birds!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_IGD_083B_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Let's give Major Gordon
the good news.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_000A_ROOK:
^1US MARINE: ^7Confirmed, Sir.
AA guns knocked out.
Skies clear all the way to Bloody Nose Ridge.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_001A_POLO_A: ^1POLONSKY: ^7Aww shit... Sarge, we got a problem.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_002A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Sir, Japanese reinforcements
coming in north of the airfield...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_205A_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Where the hell did all those
reinforcements come from?!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_006B_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay strong.
We are holding this airfield!
common.SUBTITLE_US_1_ORDER_ATTACK_INFANTRY_05: ^1US MARINE: ^7This is it Marines, let's get them!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL2_OUT_008A_ROOK:
^1US MARINE: ^7Yes, sir. The airfield has been held...
Repeat, the airfield has been held.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_100A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Our Tanks are getting hammered
by mortar fire!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_101A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We're need to clear these trenches
and knock out each mortar pit!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_106A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Throw some smoke for cover!
Or it will rip us to shreds!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_120A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Taken out. One more pit to clear.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_122A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Take cover!
Behind the barrels, get down!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_126A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get in there and clear those tunnels!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_129A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Radio command, tell 'em
we've cleared the mortar pits.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_131A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7Sir, mortar pits have 
been neutralized... Tanks are now 
en route to the point.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_133A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7We have confirmed
sightings of Japanese reinforcements on the move.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_139A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7They'll be right on us
within six hours.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_140A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7They'll be right on us
within four hours.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_141A_RADO:
^1RADIO OPERATOR: ^7They'll be right on us
within two hours.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_144A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7They recapture these trenches,
and we're right back to square one.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_149A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I don't care if the emperor's
damn picture's on it!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1A_IGD_149A_ROEB_SAFE:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7I don't care if the emperor's
picture's on it!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_000A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7The 200mm on the point
still has white beach targeted.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_001A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We all saw first hand what that
means when he hit shore.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_002A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Any attempt to bring in reinforcements
just leads to the same outcome...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_004A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Yeah... well...  
Major Gordon's suspended any further landings
until the guns are knocked out.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_006A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Tojo's got a network of tunnels and caves
running through the whole damn rock...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_006A_ROEB_SAFE:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Tojo's got a network of tunnels and caves
running through the whole rock...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_007A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We're trying to flush 'em out with the dogs...
but we all know how stubborn these bastards are.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_007A_ROEB_SAFE:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We're trying to flush 'em out with the dogs...
but we all know how stubborn these animals are.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_009A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7They'll come at us from all sides.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_013A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Find some cover, fast! GO GO GO!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_017A_POLO: ^1POLONSKY: ^7We got artillery coming from the northeast!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_018A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We need to move up and knock 'em out!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_026A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Clear it out! So our tanks can move up!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_029A_USR1: ^1US MARINE: ^7Get your damn hands off me!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_037A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Our tanks should be able to provide
some cover as we close in around the hill.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_038A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7But it'll be up to us to clear the caves...
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_040A_POLO: ^1POLONSKY: ^7Dammit!  Do the airforce know we're here?!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_041A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay in cover till they finish their run!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_045A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay with the tank!  Use it for cover!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_046A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Watch the fire!... Stay behind the tank!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_047A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Polonsky, take the one on the right!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_IGD_048A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Polonsky, take the one on the left!
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_002B_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7How many Marines did we lose
taking this rock?
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_004A_ROOK:
^1US MARINE: ^7Relay the message to Major Gordon.
The artillery on the point has been knocked out.
Yes sir.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_009A_PFOR: ^1US MARINE: ^7Hey, Grigson.  How you doin' on ammo?
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_010A_PGRI:
^1US MARINE: ^7Just swell... 
So long as they don't expect me to shoot anyone else.
common.SUBTITLE_PEL1B_OUT_011A_PFOR:
^1US MARINE: ^7What good is all that ammo
doin' sitting back at command?
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_001A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Yeah... I see 'em... Landry, open up comms.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_002A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Major Gordon...
Vessels are now in visual range.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_004A_MAJG:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7They're probably re-supplying
the enemy on Okinawa.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_006A_MAJG:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Affirmative.
They're part of the enemy war machine.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_007A_MAJG: ^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Permission to engage.  Over and out.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_009A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Laughlin, Locke! Get to your stations!
Start picking targets!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_INT_010A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Locke!  Get you thumb out your ass
and pull that damn trigger!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_005A_LAUG:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Damn right they're re-supplying the enemy!
Decks are loaded with ammunition!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_005A_LAUG_SAFE:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Darn right they're re-supplying the enemy!
Decks are loaded with ammunition!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_009A_LAUG:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Concentrate on their cargo!
Blow that shit up!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_009A_LAUG_SAFE:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Concentrate on their cargo!
Blow it all up!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_012A_HARR:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Small arms fire coming
from the decks!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_014A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Aim for the fuel barrels on deck.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_308A_HARR:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Damn it, Locke!
Watch where you're aiming!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_200A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Harrington, take her in low!
We'll assault from above!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_200B_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Hammerhead, take her in low!
We'll assault from above!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_026A_LAUG:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7What the fuck are merchant ships
doing with that much firepower?!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_026A_LAUG_SAFE:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7What are merchant ships
doing with that much firepower?!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_029A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7We still got those support boats to deal with.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_041A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Shit!   Tell me we've not lost our gunner!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_041A_BOOT_SAFE: ^1BOOTH: ^7Tell me we've not lost our gunner!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_043A_LAUG:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Shit!!!  Anyone see flak guns
on that first pass?!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_043A_LAUG_SAFE: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Anyone see flak guns on that first pass?!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_044A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7That must be some pretty important
cargo they're carrying.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_045A_LAUG: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7We need to get below the flak!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_047A_LAUG: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7I can't line up a decent shot!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_049A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7I'll take us as close as we can...
We need to wrap this up! This is our last pass.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_055A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Good work, Locke.
You've saved a lot of lives on Okinawa.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_056A_LAUG:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Shit. I think we disabled them,
but they're still afloat.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_056A_LAUG_SAFE:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7I think we disabled them,
but they're still afloat.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_057A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7I doubt the Japanese
can salvage anything...
Good enough, Locke.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_059A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Get some altitude. Headin' back to base.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_061A_HARR:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7We got pretty roughed up on
that last run, Booth.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_061B_HARR:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7We got pretty roughed up on
that last run, Mantaray.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_062A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7Confirmed, Harrington...
You got smoke comin' from your number two engine.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_062B_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7Confirmed, Hammerhead...
You got smoke comin' from your number two engine.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_063A_HARR:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Gauges ain't hitting red...
We should be able to hold her...
As long as we don't run into any more
trouble with the enemy.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_065A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7Captain... Distress call coming in...
The fleet's been hit, hard.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_065B_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7Captain... Distress call coming in...
The fleet's been hit en route to Okinawa.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_406A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7At least one Infantry transport ship
has already gone down.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_067A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7Request that all available crews participate
in rescue operations. They have men in the water...
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_068A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Okay... Locke, seal the ventral hatch.
We'll be putting down on the ocean...
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_073A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Take down as many of those
damn planes as you can!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_073A_BOOT_SAFE:
^1BOOTH: ^7Take down as many of those
planes as you can!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_074A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Radio the fleet! Tell them Tojo's
headed right at them!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_076A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Your number two engine
is a ball of fire, shut it down!  Shut it down!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_077A_HARR: ^1HARRINGTON: ^7I am trying! The controls are shot to hell!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_077A_HARR_SAFE: ^1HARRINGTON: ^7I am trying! The controls are shot!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_078A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Hold it together, HARRINGTON!
HOLD IT TOGETHER!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_079A_HARR:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Mayday! Mayday! 
We are going down, I say again we are going...
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_081A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Okay people... the fleet still needs our help...
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_084A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7We're going into a hot zone.
I want everyone sharp and ready for anything.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_085A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Bastards wiped out most of our ships.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_085A_BOOT_SAFE: ^1BOOTH: ^7Animals wiped out most of our ships.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_086A_LAUG:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Holy shit... Do you think anyone's
gonna be alive down there?
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_086A_LAUG_SAFE:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Do you think anyone's gonna
be alive down there?
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_087A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7I see multiple casualties in the water.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_089A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7We better not be the only ones
responding to the distress call.
We ain't got room for all of them.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_090A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7We'll do what we can... Taking us down.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_091A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7LOCKE!  Be ready to pull those men in.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_093A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7More of our boys in the water.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_095A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7Sink those damn PT boats!
Before they rip our men to shreds!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_095A_LAND_SAFE:
^1LANDRY: ^7Sink those PT boats! 
Before they rip our men to shreds!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_100A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7We need to get to those men!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_101A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7They'll have to wait till we deal
with the PT boats...
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_120A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Do you see anyone else in the water?
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_123A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Laughlin! Make sure we're not taking water!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_125A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Locke! Take his place on the dual 30.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_126A_LAUG: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7Port side's pretty torn up, but we're holding!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_129A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Keep 'em off what's left of the fleet!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_130A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Locke! You need to take out
some of those Zeroes before I can take us up!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_131A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Stay on that trigger. It's all on you...
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_132B_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7This is Black Cat squadron leader
Mantaray 54...
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_133A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7The fleet is down. Repeat the fleet is down!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_134A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7We have multiple casualties in the water!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_137A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Landry! Any word on that air support?
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_139A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Keep trying...
We better pray that they show up!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_144A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Not yet, Laughlin.  We can't abandon our men!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_145A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7Laughlin!  Keep those planes off our men!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_146A_LAUG: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7I'm trying!  There's too many of them!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_154A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Landry, get that man into a bunk!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_542A_LAUG:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7We got smoke coming from
our number two engine!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_548A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7Much more of this and we'll lose that engine!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_549A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7We have a hull breach right above me!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_155A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Good work, Locke...
Landry, how we holding up?
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_156A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7Hull's intact... Props spinning...
That's enough to get us outta here...
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_159A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7Bunk's are full...
Thanks to Locke, we got six men.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_160A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7We pulled five men on board...
Good job, Locke.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_161A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7Locke did pretty good... We got four.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_162A_LAND:
^1LANDRY: ^7There were too many damn Zeroes...
We only got three.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_162A_LAND_SAFE:
^1LANDRY: ^7There were too many Zeroes...
We only got three.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_163A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7We just got two and they're in a bad way.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_164A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7We only got one... Let's pray he makes it.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_165A_LAND: ^1LANDRY: ^7We struck out... just get us out of here.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_314A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Laughlin, patch us up as best you can.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_167A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Oh no... NO! Landry. we got incoming!
12 O'Clock!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_168A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7It's the enemy...
And there's a fucking shitload of them.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_168A_BOOT_SAFE:
^1BOOTH: ^7It's the enemy...
And there's a whole bunch of them.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_OUT_006A_CAIR:
^1CORSAIR PILOT: ^7Black Cat Mantaray 54.
Havok 26, coming over you now.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_503A_LAUG:
^1LAUGHLIN: ^7I can see the wake behind them,
but not much else!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_506A_HARR:
^1HARRINGTON: ^7Goddammit!!!
Sink them before they sink us!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_524A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7We need you on the right turret!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_527A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7We need you on the left turret!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_530A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Get up front! Maintain fire on those ships!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_531A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Stay on those damn merchant ships!...
Head up front!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_531A_BOOT_SAFE:
^1BOOTH: ^7Stay on those merchant ships!...
Head up front!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_532A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7We need you on the front turret!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_535A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7We need you on the rear turret!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_536A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Get on the rear gun!
Taking MG fire on our six!!!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_538A_BOOT:
^1BOOTH: ^7Are you hearing me?!!!
HIT THOSE MERCHANT SHIPS!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_602A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7You put a lotta holes in that PT Boat.
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_605A_LAUG: ^1LAUGHLIN: ^7You tore that PT boat to pieces!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_631A_BOOT: ^1BOOTH: ^7Let's hope there's enough left on the front!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_570A_USR3:
^1US SEAMAN: ^7Get me outta here!
Please god, get me out of here!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_577A_USR1:
^1US SEAMAN: ^7There's more coming,
get me outta the fucking water, get me out!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_577A_USR1_SAFE:
^1US SEAMAN: ^7There's more coming,
get me outta the water, get me out!
common.SUBTITLE_PBY1_IGD_580A_USR1: ^1US SEAMAN: ^7Oh god, oh my god, oh god, (whining)
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_002A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Major Gordon's ordered another
attack on the enemy stronghold beyond this ridge.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_007A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We got a heavily fortified MG in that bunker.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_018A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Through the caves...
There's more bunkers up ahead.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_102A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7You know what to do! Bring 'em down!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_027A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We need to knock out those bunkers!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_103A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get to it, Miller! Take out that bunker!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_105A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get some damn fire on those bunkers!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_034A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Our tanks are moving up...
Convoy won't be far behind...
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_112A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay in cover. Let's get through this...
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_035A_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7That our objective?
It's a damn  fortress!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_039A_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Roebuck! We can flank 'em!
I see paths around either side!!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_115A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7The Major's convoy is en route.
After this, we'll be on easy street.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_123A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Now let's get out of this damn hole
and start dealing with our wounded...
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_IGD_123A_ROEB_SAFE:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Now let's get out of this hole
and start dealing with our wounded...
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_000A_POLO_SAFE:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Keep moving you animals...
You're running out of places to hide...
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_002A_ROEB_A: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Hold on kid, we're gonna get you out of here.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_003A_ROEB_A: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Help me get him on the truck.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_006A_ROEB_A: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7It's not bad, okay? It's not bad.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_008A_MAJG: ^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Push ahead and take Shuri Castle.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_010A_MAJG:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7You'll have a supply drop
tomorrow morning.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_011A_POLO_A:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Tomorrow?!!...
How the hell are we supposed to hold out till tomorrow?!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_011A_POLO_SAFE:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Tomorrow?!!...
How are we supposed to hold out till tomorrow?!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_013A_POLO_A:
^1POLONSKY: ^7You hear this, Sarge?
We ain't getting shit 'til tomorrow morning.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_013A_POLO_SAFE:
^1POLONSKY: ^7You hear this, Sarge?
We ain't getting nothin' 'til tomorrow morning.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_014A_MAJG:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Intel says Shuri Castle
is mostly deserted.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_016A_MAJG:
^1MAJOR GORDON: ^7Look on the bright side...
After this, you boys will probably get relieved
and be on the boat home...
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_017B_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Yeah? That's what we
thought after Peleliu...
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_500A_COR2: ^1US MARINE: ^7You have to stay calm, okay?
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_501A_COR2:
^1US MARINE: ^7You're conscious and alert,
that's a good sign... Trust me.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI2_OUT_503A_COR2: ^1US MARINE: ^7Keep pressure on the wound, okay?
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_200A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Word is, the main force
pulled back to the north ridge..
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_201A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7...But I want everyone ready to fight.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_202A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Watch the grass... Watch the trees...
Watch any damn place Tojo could be waiting.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_202A_ROEB_SAFE:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Watch the grass... Watch the trees...
Watch any place Tojo could be waiting.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_000A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Soon as that supply drop shows, we move.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_203A_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Our planes bombed
the shit outta the place...
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_204A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7They'll be back.
Soon as they're refueled and rearmed.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_003A_ROEB_A: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7This is all we've got. Share it out.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_008A_POLO: ^1POLONSKY: ^7They must have been waiting all night!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_009A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7They won't be the only ones... eyes wide.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_013A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7They zeroed our position pretty damn quick...
There must be spotters holed up in the tunnels.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_013A_ROEB_SAFE:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7They zeroed our position pretty quick...
There must be spotters holed up in the tunnels.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_018A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Good luck. We'll regroup on the other side!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_019A_POLO_A:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Dammit, Miller...
I almost plugged you there!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_020A_POLO_A:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Come on.
We're pushing deeper into the castle.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_027A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Stay in cover and take it out!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_218A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Use the enemy's weapons if you have to!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_029A_ROEB_A:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Push forward!
We've got to take out those mortars!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_031A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7I want men moving up each side! GO!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_222A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Grab a mortar shell and throw it!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_501A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7We can throw their own
mortars right on them!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_036A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7One down! Get to the next one!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_223A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Clear the area before we move up!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_038A_POLO: ^1POLONSKY: ^7There's more mortar pits beyond the wall!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_039A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Blow up the gatehouse!
Bring down that barricade!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_226A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7We got another MG on our left flank!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_100A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Get to it, Miller! Take out that Mortar pit!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_230A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7Planes should be en route to assist.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_231A_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7Good...
They can blow this place to kingdom come.
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_255A_ROEB:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Looks like our planes
did most of the work...
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_305A_POLO: ^1POLONSKY: ^7You're all going to hell, y'hear me???
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_305A_POLO_SAFE: ^1POLONSKY: ^7You're all going to die, y'hear me???
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_306A_POLO_SAFE: ^1POLONSKY: ^7I'm going to kill every last one of you!!!!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_316A_POLO:
^1POLONSKY: ^7You hear that?
Call in those fucking planes!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_316A_POLO_SAFE:
^1POLONSKY: ^7You hear that?
Call in those planes!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_319A_POLO: ^1POLONSKY: ^7Do it, Miller! Call in those planes!
common.SUBTITLE_OKI3_IGD_341A_ROEB: ^1ROEBUCK: ^7You hear that? Call in the planes!
common.SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_00B:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Everything that was asked
of us, we've done.
common.SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_01B:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Every night we lay in a filthy foxhole...
Prayin' the enemy won't slit our throats.
common.SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_02B:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7Every day we spent crawling
through the mud and dirt 
while bullets whistled all around.
common.SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_03C:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7But this is the last time we're
gonna have to put our lives on the line.
common.SUBTITLE_US_LOADINGMOVIE_OKI3_04B:
^1ROEBUCK: ^7This is the enemy's last stand.
When we take Shuri Castle, we go home.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_100A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Do what I say, and we can
avenge this massacre.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_101A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7My injured hand means I can no longer aim.
You will do it for me.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_003B_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Take my rifle and watch the road.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_004A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak in the car is
General Heinrich Amsel architect of Stalingrad's misery.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_005A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7He is responsible for the cold blooded 
murder of men, women and children...
Not just here, but throughout the motherland.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_006A_REZN_C:
^1REZNOV: ^7For three days I have hunted him. 
For three days luck alone has saved his wretched life.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_011A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Sniping your enemy is like hunting
any other animal.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_012A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Fire at the wrong moment and your
chance will be forever lost.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_008A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Now, load your rifle, but hold your fire.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_009A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Wait until the bombers are directly overhead.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_010A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7The sound of their engines will
drown out your shot.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_102A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7If we reveal our position to Amsel's men,
this fountain will be our grave.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_027A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Your reactions could be quicker,
but the job is done.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_029A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Excellent aim!  You are a natural hunter.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_104A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7You have given away our position!
Go down fighting!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_205A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7You have let our chance for vengeance
slip through our fingers!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_030A_REZN_C: ^1REZNOV: ^7Time to close in for the kill.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_032A_REZN_B:
^1REZNOV: ^7Armored patrol...
We must find another route to Amsel.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_033A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7This way, before they discover their dead.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_035A_REZN_C:
^1REZNOV: ^7For days I have crept through
shadows like a rat.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_037A_REZN_C:
^1REZNOV: ^7This place once echoed
with conversations of friends and lovers.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_041A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7We will take the fight to their land... 
to their people... to their blood.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_043A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Knowing the routines and movements
of your prey tips the balance of a hunt.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_044A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7General Amsel is a creature of habit.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_045A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7He inspects each German garrison every day.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_046A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7We can use this building to flank his route.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_049A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Svoloch almost got me.
We'll have to flush him out before we move on.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_051A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7The shot came from across the river!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_052A_REZN_B: ^1REZNOV: ^7Now the game is cat and mouse.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_053A_REZN_B:
^1REZNOV: ^7I will draw his fire.
Keep your eyes open for the flash.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_056A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's on the fourth floor, right side!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_056B_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's on the top floor, right side!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_058A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's on the fourth floor, left side!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_058B_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's on the top floor, left side!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_060A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7I'm going to draw his fire again,
get ready to take him out...
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_064A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7I cannot risk it again...
It's up to you to find him now.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_065A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Stay out of the light.  If he fires, move.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_066A_REZN_B: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's spotted you, get over to the window!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_068A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7You need to take a different position!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_109A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Your shots tell him exactly where you are!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_071A_REZN_B:
^1REZNOV: ^7The patrols will surely have
heard those shots.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_077A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7They are trying to burn us out!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_214A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7We need to find a way out!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_301A_DALE:
^1DALETSKI: ^7We thought you were among the
dead in the massacre at the square!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_302A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7He was. Among them, but not one of them.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_303A_DALE:
^1DALETSKI: ^7We're about to assault
the communication post north of here...
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_304A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Good. Such a move will prevent
the German command calling for help.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_305A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri and I will provide cover from above...
Wait till you hear the screams of dying Germans.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_806A_DALE: ^1DALETSKI: ^7Take positions and wait for the signal...
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_307A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Hold your fire.  Do you see the flamethrowers?
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_309A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Exploding the fuel tank will incinerate
anyone standing nearby.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_317A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Give covering fire to our comrades below!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_400A_REZN_C: ^1REZNOV: ^7(laughing) You are a true marksman, Dimitri!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_324A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7German reinforcements!
Moving on to the left balcony!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_326A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Our friends are moving up.
We must do the same!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_329A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Do you feel your heart beat
faster as we get closer to our prey?
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_330A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7General Amsel will soon be in our sights.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_331A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Get into position and give covering fire!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_407A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep firing! Our friends below need cover!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_703A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Our comrades are clearing the building!
Watch your fire!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_900A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri! If you tire of sniping you can
use the mounted MG!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_334A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7They have taken the communication post.
Amsel will try to run.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_335A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Quickly! We must cut off his escape route!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_704A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Follow me... I know a perfect sniping position
overlooking the command post.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_409A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7There is nothing we can do for our comrades...
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_707A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7The death of General Amsel
will be just the beginning...
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_410A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7We are too close to our goal to reveal our position.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_807A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7You see?!! They will still die and now
you have given away our position!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_336A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Look ahead...
The building adorned with flags is the German command post...
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_340A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The sounds of battle will flush him out.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_902A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Watch the building.
He will be coming out any second now.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_412A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Put a bullet in his bodyguard's head!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_414B_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel has moved behind the artillery piece!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_414C_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The Mudak is behind the artillery piece!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_415C_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is behind the smoking car!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_416C_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is getting into that car!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_708B_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is hiding behind the destroyed tank!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_708C_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is hiding behind the destroyed tank!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_709A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's using the destroyed tank for cover!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_709B_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is using the destroyed tank for cover!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_709C_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is using the destroyed tank for cover!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_711A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7He's using the burning truck for cover!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_712B_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is cowering behind the artillery piece!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_712C_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is cowering behind the artillery piece!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_713B_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is using the halftrack for cover!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_713C_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is using the halftrack for cover!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_714B_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Amsel is taking cover by the halftrack!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_714C_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The mudak is taking cover by the halftrack!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_718A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7You must first kill his sniper to get a clear shot!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_809A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Only a true marksman nails his
target with no scope!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_353A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7We have struck a great blow for the city...
for all of Russia.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_419A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7They will be coming for us! We  must go!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_726A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep moving before it tears us apart!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_421A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Into the river, Dimitri! It is our only chance!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_503A_REZN_C: ^1REZNOV: ^7Are you trying to get us killed!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_504A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Stay with me.
The area is full of German patrols!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_506A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7We cannot afford to be drawn
into needless battles.
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_508A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7A hunter has to stay hidden from his prey!
common.SUBTITLE_SNI1_IGD_510A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Killing Amsel is worth more than any other life...
Including yours.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_INT_014A_REZN_A_CA: ^1REZNOV: ^7Our tanks are ready to smash this line and...
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_INT_016A_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7There is no point, Sergeant...
They are already bleeding to death.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_INT_017A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Then maybe our friend will help
them to bleed faster.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_000A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7See how things have changed, my friend?
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_001A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Now it is their land... Their people...
Their blood.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_003A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Yes, Chernov... But that will not save them.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_007A_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Are we to shoot them in the back?
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_008A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7The back.  The front.  The head!...
Wherever you wish! Just so long as they are dead!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_009A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Hunt them down like the rats they are.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_012A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7After Stalingrad, I know to trust
your instincts, Dimitri.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_013A_REZN_B: ^1REZNOV: ^7Left or right?... You lead the way.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_015A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Let their burning country be the last
thing they see!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_104A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7As our planes lay waste this land,
we will deal with its animals on the ground!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_105A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri...
Flank the MG before it cuts us all down!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_019A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Throw some Molotovs.
Let them burn in their posts.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_019B_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Use your Molotovs.
Let them burn in their posts.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_107A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7I told you Chernov! There will be no escape!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_022A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Our tanks are moving into the fields!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_029A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7More Panzershreck fire! Take them all out!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_117A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep going until the last one burns!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_109A_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7How? Our rifles are no match for their armor?
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_037A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri, I see time has not weakened your aim!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_041A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Their armor is no match for you!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_123A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7The cowards may hide in shadows,
but we will find them!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_043A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Stay back! Let our armor deal it!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_045A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Follow me! We will regroup at the barn!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_046A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7There... We will prepare for the final
push to the train station.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_050A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7You could learn much from this man, Chernov...
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_051A_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7Sergeant Reznov,
you seem to relish in the slaughter.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_052A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7I have seen friends and neighbors
die at the hands of this vermin.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_052B_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7I have seen my friends die
in front me at the hands of this vermin.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_053A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7They deserve everything they get...
and more.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_054A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Enough talk.
We must push forward to the train station!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_124A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri, ride on one of the tanks.
You have earned the rest.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_126A_RUR1:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7No room, Comrade.
Try the tank behind.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_127A_RUR1: ^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Are you blind?  There is no space.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_128B_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Germans in the field to the left!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_129A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7HA! They scatter like cockroaches in the light!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_131A_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7The path is blocked...
Our tanks cannot move up.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_057A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7When we clear this compound
we can revel in a great victory.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_139A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri!  Blow it to pieces
before they take positions!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_140A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7You may be the Red army's greatest asset!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_143A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7If you are out of rockets,
then put a bullet in the gunner's head!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_145A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7It matters not where they choose to die!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_148A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7We are not ready to let them.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_149A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7No mercy was shown to my
comrades in Stalingrad.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_200A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Victory is at hand! The German cowards 
desert their posts, but they have nowhere left to run!
Smash all that remains of their broken line 
and seize the train station. From this moment on...
Every step we take brings us closer to Berlin.
Closer to victory! Closer to revenge! URA!!!!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_200B_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Victory is at hand! The German cowards 
desert their posts, but they have nowhere left to run!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE1_IGD_200C_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7From this moment on...  
Every step we take brings us closer to Berlin.
Closer to victory! Closer to revenge! URA!!!!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_001A_COMM: ^1COMMISSAR: ^7Today we lay waste to the German line!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_003A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Good.  Now, take a closer look
at those rats on the horizon!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_004A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7They will be the first to burn this day!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_009A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Ha! The first of many, my friend!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_011A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Remember, we are vulnerable
when reloading. Make every shell count!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_013A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Destroy it!  The Panther's speed
makes it a deadly adversary!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_020A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Push forward!!!
More 88s remain, west and south of your position!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_022A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Stay on the road or push through the field!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_025A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Two more remain, over to the north!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_030A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Two more. Two more, over to the south!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_032A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7We are vulnerable to attack from all sides!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_042A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Attention, Comrades!
Push forward and obliterate the Fascist radio tower.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_046A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Good work Dimitri, there will
be no cry for reinforcements!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_048A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Move in to destroy the fuel depot!
Cripple their military machine!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_532A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7We will fight on to the train station...
And then, onto Berlin!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_536A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The final push before we move onto Berlin.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_202A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Show them the fury they have unleashed!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_507A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7The hide of the King Tiger is strong!
FIRE AGAIN!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_111A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7We could be burning Germans right now!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_530A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7If we take much more, we will burn to death!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_703A_COMM: ^1COMMISSAR: ^7The train station is within our grasp!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_704A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7As our planes rain death from above,
crush their final positions!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_004A_RUR1:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7I killed at least twenty!
Three of them with my bare hands!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_005A_RUR2:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Liar! When we were knee deep
in blood, you were crawling on your belly!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_006A_RUR2:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7You are lucky the Commissar
was not around!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_007A_RUR2:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7He would have had
you shot for cowardice!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_008A_RUR1:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7What about brave Chernov?
How many did you kill... Three?
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_001A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7In Berlin, the Germans will truly
see what they have unleashed!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_012A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7In the midst of all the blood,
the bullets and the dead... I found that
an old friend was still very much alive...
Dimitri Petrenko!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_013A_REZN_B:
^1REZNOV: ^7I saw this man cheat death... 
Time after time at the siege of Stalingrad.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_OUT_014A_REZN_B:
^1REZNOV: ^7As long as HE lives,
the heart of this army cannot be broken.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_533A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7More Panzershreck fire! Take them all out!
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_534A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7There... We will prepare for the final
push to the train station.
common.SUBTITLE_SEE2_IGD_535A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Enough talk. We must push
forward to the train station!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_000A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Cut slowly... Always, cut slowly...
Your blade is part of you...
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_001A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7When you reach the head...
Start at the mouth.
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_005A_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7I do not think we will find
many bears in Berlin.
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_008A_COMM_A:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7On the Fuhrer's birthday...
A barrage of Katyushka rockets will tear Berlin to pieces.
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_009A_COMM_A:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7With your bullets... With your bayonets...
With your bare hands...
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_INT_010A_COMM: ^1COMMISSAR: ^7Do the same to their wretched soldiers!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_006A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Of course, Chernov! 
But they have nowhere to go!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_011A_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7They have set up defenses
in the clocktower!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_015A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri, find a better position
upstairs in that building!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_032A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7These animals raped
and marauded their way through
the motherland without mercy!!!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_039A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Split up! You four, go through the courtyard!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_040A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7The rest of you, clear the street!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_042A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Hunt them down in whatever corner they hide!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_043A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7This place reeks of nightmares and madness.
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_045A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7But only the insane would stand against us!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_301A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7We will be killing at close quarters!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_063A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Citizens of Berlin! A ring of steel
surrounds your rotten city!
common.SUBTITLE_BER1_IGD_064A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7We will crush all who dare
to resist the will of the Red army!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_301A_RUR3:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7What mercy did you
show to our people!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_303A_RUR3: ^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Wait... Wait!  He may help us!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_304A_RUR1: ^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Help us?!!  He can die for us.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_004A_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7This is not war. This is murder.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_005A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7This is how you end a war, Chernov.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_006A_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7This is madness!
Our rockets are tearing the city apart!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_030A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Stay on your guard...
They may be cowering in the dark.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_034A_RUR1:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Killing me will not save you.
My comrades show no mercy.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_043B_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Dimitri, throw a Molotov down there!
Burn them!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_051A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Stay low. Smoke can steal your breath.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_054A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7Complaining will not help... Just keep low.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_055A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7In Stalingrad, Dimitri and I
crawled through many smoke filled buildings.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_058A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Berlin will be in ruins
by the time war is over.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_068A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Look around you, Chernov...
Do you think these men will be denied their revenge?
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_069A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Death comes only two ways,
fast or slow.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_070A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Chernov, you should learn from Dimitri...
He understands the nature of mercy killing.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_071A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7You should have shot them, Chernov.
It is only cruel to prolong an animal's suffering.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_201A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Move faster!
We have to escape the barrage!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_083A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Give your eyes a moment
to adjust to the darkness.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_405A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Find your targets as soon
as the lights come on.
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_413A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7We need to take out that MG!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_089A_RUR2:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7We are going to be crushed...
Or buried alive!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_091A_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7We need to find a way out!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_093A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7There will be an exit at the other
end of the platform!
common.SUBTITLE_BER2_IGD_094A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep firing! I need to get the gate open!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_300A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7They flooded their own metro
in an effort to kill us, Dimitri...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_000A_REZN_B: ^1REZNOV: ^7You will be okay... Do you hear me?
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_002A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Brave comrades.
This day, the Nazi empire will yield
to the iron fist of the Red Army.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_003A_REZN_C: ^1REZNOV: ^7Relax for a few minutes. Breathe deeply.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_004A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Cut down those in front of you
as though they are but fields of wheat and rye.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_005A_REZN_C:
^1REZNOV: ^7Which do you think will lead us home?
Writing about this war or fighting it?
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_008A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7If you lack the stomach to kill for your country ...
at least show me that you are willing to die for it.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_009A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Drown this wretched Germany
in the blood of its own!!!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_010A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7We are in the final hours
of Berlin's downfall...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_013A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Take the left flank and eradicate
whatever scum remains in defense of each building.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_INT_015A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7You heard him, comrades...
To the left!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_000A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7The Germans hang
their cowards from trees.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_000B_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7The Germans hang
their cowards by the neck.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_001A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Make sure you keep hold
of that flag, Chernov.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_006A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Our tanks will have to find
another way around.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_010A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Today is the day of our glorious
vengeance! For ourselves... and for mother Russia!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_012A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7We need to destroy the 88s
before our can armor move up!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_016A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Do whatever it takes to blow
the bastards to hell!!!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3_IGD_016A_REZN_SAFE:
^1REZNOV: ^7Do whatever it takes to blow
them to pieces!
common.SUBTITLE_RU_REZ_THREAT_INFANTRY_EXPOSED_: ^1REZNOV: ^7This is what you came here for!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_101A_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7When he first spoke of Dimitri,
Reznov told tales of a hero...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_102A_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Someone we should all aspire to be like...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_103A_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7His merciless brutality defines
him only as a savage...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_104A_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Just like the rest of the red army.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_101B_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7When he first spoke of Dimitri,
Reznov told tales of a hero...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_102B_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Someone we should all aspire to be like...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_103B_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7His bravery on the battlefield is beyond question.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_104B_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7But he has also shown mercy
amidst the brutality of the Red army.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_101C_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7When he first spoke of Dimitri,
Reznov told tales of a hero...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_102C_CHER: ^1CHERNOV: ^7Someone we should all aspire to be like...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_103C_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7At times I have seen him show mercy
and at others act with complete brutality.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_105C_CHER:
^1CHERNOV: ^7Perhaps heroes need not
question their actions.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_001A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Steel yourselves, men.
For the final push to victory.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_002A_COMM_A:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7The SS honor guard defending
this building will fight to their last breath.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_003A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Today, we crush what remains
of their fascist Reich.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_004A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Show courage... Show strength...
Show pride... But show NO mercy.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_005A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7As heroes we will return to Russia's embrace...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_INT_006A_COMM:
^1COMMISSAR: ^7Crush the last remnants of resistance
and this night our flag will fly over this city...
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_000A_RUR2:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7The building's still being shelled!!!
We could be killed!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_001A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Then die with your hands around
the throat of the enemy!!!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_005A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Keep him covered! Keep that flag raised!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_008A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7MG's, dead ahead. I count three of them!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_009A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7The rest of you, keep on them...
Do whatever it takes!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_010A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Obliterate those MG's before
they rip us to shreds!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_018A_SSHG: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7For the glory of the Reich!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_019A_SSHG: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7Give your lives for the Fuhrer!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_020A_SSHG: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7Berlin will never be yours!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_111A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Deal with it any way you can!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_034A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Be on your guard... 
They'll fight to hold every strong point they can!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_035A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7Right flank! Get up on that balcony!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_037A_RUR1:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7(grunting as he struggles
with the door) GRRNAAAAR!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_038A_RUR1:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7It's being held from the other side...
I need help!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_041A_RUR2:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7AGAIN!... On three. One...
Two... Three... (GRUNT!)
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_043A_RUR1:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7We must be nearing the roof...
Look how far we've come.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_044A_RUR2:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7We should throw these animals
over the edge!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_045A_RUR1:
^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7Sergeant, our comrades
from the rear echelon are flooding the building.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_046A_REZN_A:
^1REZNOV: ^7Let them feast on our scraps.
We should push onward... to victory.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_047A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Onward, and the glory of planting
the flag will be yours.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_048A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7The bloodied heart of the fascist empire
will soon beat for the last time!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_049A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7As this symbol of their decadence plummets,
so too will their wretched Reich.
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_050A_SSHG: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7For Germany! For the Fuhrer!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_053A_SSHG: ^1S.S. HONOR GUARD: ^7Give your lives for Germany!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_054A_REZN: ^1REZNOV: ^7They have nowhere left to go! Move up!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_IGD_056A_REZN:
^1REZNOV: ^7Let them surrender their lives
to their lost cause!
common.SUBTITLE_BER3B_OUT_003A_REZN_A: ^1REZNOV: ^7The heart of this army can never be broken.
common.SUBTITLE_RU_1_ORDER_ATTACK_INFANTRY_05: ^1RUSSIAN SOLDIER: ^7We have them on the run!
common.VICTORYQUOTE_WHEN_YOU_HAVE_TO_KILL: "When you have to kill a man it costs nothing to be polite." - Winston Churchill
common.VICTORYQUOTE_BATTLES_ARE_WON_BY_SLAUGHTE: "Battles are won by slaughter and maneuver. The greater the general, the more he contributes in maneuver, the less he demands in slaughter." - Winston Churchill
common.VICTORYQUOTE_HISTORY_WILL_BE_KIND: "History will be kind to me for I intend to write it." - Winston Churchill
common.VICTORYQUOTE_NOTHING_IN_LIFE_IS_SO: "Nothing in life is so exhilarating as to be shot at without result." - Winston Churchill
common.VICTORYQUOTE_SUCCESS_IS_NOT_FINAL: "Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts." - Winston Churchill
common.VICTORYQUOTE_WE_SHALL_DEFEND_OUR_ISLAND: "We shall defend our island, whatever the cost may be, we shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the landing grounds, we shall fight in the fields and in the streets, we shall fight in the hills; we shall never surrender." - Winston Churchill
common.VICTORYQUOTE_WHEN_YOU_GET_TO_THE_END: "When you get to the end of your rope, tie a knot and hang on." - Franklin D. Roosevelt
common.VICTORYQUOTE_THE_REAL_AND_LASTING: "The real and lasting victories are those of peace, and not of war." - Ralph Waldo Emerson
common.VICTORYQUOTE_A_HERO_IS_NO_BRAVER_THAN: "A hero is no braver than an ordinary man, but he is brave five minutes longer." - Ralph Waldo Emerson
common.VICTORYQUOTE_OUR_GREATEST_GLORY_IS: "Our greatest glory is not in never failing, but in rising up every time we fail." - Ralph Waldo Emerson
common.VICTORYQUOTE_THE_CHARACTERISTIC_OF: "The characteristic of genuine heroism is its persistency. All men have wandering impulses, fits and starts of generosity. But when you have resolved to be great, abide by yourself, and do not weakly try to reconcile yourself with the world. The heroic cannot be the common, nor the common the heroic." - Ralph Waldo Emerson
common.VICTORYQUOTE_IF_THE_OPPOSITION_DISARMS: "If the opposition disarms, well and good. If it refuses to disarm, we shall disarm it ourselves." - Joseph Stalin
common.VICTORYQUOTE_THE_OBJECT_OF_WAR_IS: "The object of war is not to die for your country but to make the other bastard die for his." - General George S. Patton
common.VICTORYQUOTE_BETTER_TO_FIGHT_FOR_SOMETHI: "Better to fight for something than live for nothing." - General George S. Patton
common.VICTORYQUOTE_COURAGE_IS_FEAR_HOLDING: "Courage is fear holding on a minute longer." - General George S. Patton
common.VICTORYQUOTE_IF_A_MAN_DOES_HIS_BEST: "If a man does his best, what else is there?" - General George S. Patton
common.VICTORYQUOTE_IT_IS_FOOLISH_AND_WRONG: "It is foolish and wrong to mourn the men who died. Rather we should thank God that such men lived." - General George S. Patton
common.VICTORYQUOTE_EVERY_MANS_LIFE_ENDS: "Every man's life ends the same way. It is only the details of how he lived and how he died that distinguish one man from another." - Ernest Hemingway
common.VICTORYQUOTE_ALL_WARS_ARE_CIVIL_WARS: "All wars are civil wars, because all men are brothers." - Francois Fenelon
common.VICTORYQUOTE_I_HAVE_NEVER_ADVOCATED: "I have never advocated war except as a means of peace." - Ulysses S. Grant
common.VICTORYQUOTE_WE_HAPPY_FEW_WE_BAND: "We happy few, we band of brothers/For he today that sheds his blood with me/Shall be my brother." - William Shakespeare, King Henry V
common.VICTORYQUOTE_COWARDS_DIE_MANY_TIMES: "Cowards die many times before their deaths; The valiant never taste of death but once." - William Shakespeare, Julius Caesar
common.VICTORYQUOTE_NEVER_INTERRUPT_YOUR: "Never interrupt your enemy when he is making a mistake." - Napoleon Bonaparte
common.VICTORYQUOTE_THERE_ARE_ONLY_TWO_FORCES: "There are only two forces in the world, the sword and the spirit. In the long run the sword will always be conquered by the spirit." - Napoleon Bonaparte
common.VICTORYQUOTE_THERE_WILL_ONE_DAY_SPRING: "There will one day spring from the brain of science a machine or force so fearful in its potentialities, so absolutely terrifying, that even man, the fighter, who will dare torture and death in order to inflict torture and death, will be appalled, and so abandon war forever." - Thomas A. Edison
common.VICTORYQUOTE_THERE_ARE_NO_ATHEISTS: ""There are no atheists in foxholes" isn't an argument against atheism, it's an argument against foxholes." - James Morrow
common.VICTORYQUOTE_IF_WE_DONT_END_WAR_WAR: "If we don't end war, war will end us." - H. G. Wells
common.VICTORYQUOTE_LIVE_AS_BRAVE_MEN_AND: "Live as brave men; and if fortune is adverse, front its blows with brave hearts." - Cicero
common.VICTORYQUOTE_COURAGE_AND_PERSEVERANCE: "Courage and perseverance have a magical talisman, before which difficulties disappear and obstacles vanish into air." - John Quincy Adams
common.VICTORYQUOTE_COURAGE_IS_BEING_SCARED: "Courage is being scared to death - but saddling up anyway." - John Wayne
common.VICTORYQUOTE_ABOVE_ALL_THINGS_NEVER: "Above all things, never be afraid. The enemy who forces you to retreat is himself afraid of you at that very moment." - Andre Maurois
common.VICTORYQUOTE_I_HAVE_NEVER_MADE_BUT: "I have never made but one prayer to God, a very short one: 'O Lord, make my enemies ridiculous.' And God granted it." - Voltaire
common.VICTORYQUOTE_SAFEGUARDING_THE_RIGHTS: "Safeguarding the rights of others is the most noble and beautiful end of a human being." - Kahlil Gibran, "The Voice of the Poet"
common.VICTORYQUOTE_IT_IS_BETTER_TO_DIE_ON: "It is better to die on your feet than to live on your knees!" - Emiliano Zapata
common.VICTORYQUOTE_YOU_KNOW_THE_REAL_MEANING: "You know the real meaning of peace only if you have been through the war." - Kosovar
common.VICTORYQUOTE_THOSE_WHO_HAVE_LONG_ENJOYED: "Those who have long enjoyed such privileges as we enjoy forget in time that men have died to win them." - Franklin D. Roosevelt
common.VICTORYQUOTE_IN_WAR_THERE_IS_NO_SUBSTITU: "In war there is no substitute for victory." - General Douglas MacArthur
common.VICTORYQUOTE_WAR_IS_A_SERIES_OF_CATASTRO: "War is a series of catastrophes which result in victory." - Georges Clemenceau

localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_WHILE_LOOKING_THROUGH: While looking through the binoculars press USE^3 &&1 ^7to call in Artillery.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_PICK_UP_SLEIGHT_OF_HAND: Press^3 &&1 ^7to pick up Sleight of Hand
