localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_STATSREADERROR: An error occurred while reading the stats data.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG1: Experience points (XP) are awarded for kills, completing Challenges and matches.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG2: Gaining experience points (XP) allow you to rank up and unlock new Weapons, Attachments, Perks and Challenges.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG3: Completing weapon Challenges unlocks attachments that allow you to customize weapons in the Create-A-Class menu.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG4: Create customized weapon loadouts and Perk assignments in the Create-A-Class menu.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG5: Assist points are awarded when you damage an enemy, but your teammate gets the kill.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG6: Hardcore mode removes the HUD and increases weapon damage.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG7: Visit Treyarch.com to go behind-the-scenes with the developers behind 'Call of Duty: World at War'.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG8: You can invite your friends to join you on the server that you are playing on by clicking on Friends from the pause menu in game.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG9: Hosting a game will allow you to customize the game rules.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG10: Satchel Charges and Nº 74 ST grenades can aid you in destroying tanks.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG11: See how many experience points (XP) until your next level in the Rank & Challenges menu.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG12: Earn experience points (XP) by completing Challenges in online games. View your progress on a specific Challenge in the Rank & Challenges menu.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG13: Using the Shades perk will reduce the intensity of Signal Flares.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG14: Using the Bomb Squad perk will allow you to spot enemy explosives like Bouncing Betty's and Satchel Charges.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG15: The Second Chance perk allows you to revive downed teammates who also have Second Chance.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG16: Recon Planes called in by teammates offer an opportunity to call in accurate Artillery Strikes.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG17: Enemy dogs can be damaged with any weapon or explosive.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG18: The Recon Plane will show enemy positions on the compass and in-game map.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG19: In the War game mode your team loses Momentum if the enemy captures a battlefield command point.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG20: The Domination game mode is about holding the marked objectives. The more objectives you hold, the more points your team gets.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG21: In the Search and Destroy game mode you won't respawn until the round is over.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG22: The Sabotage game mode is about protecting the bomb carrier. The key to victory is teamwork.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG23: Killing 3 enemies in a row without dying will reward you and your team with a Recon Plane.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG24: Killing 5 enemies in a row without dying will reward you and your team with an Artillery Strike.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG25: Killing 7 enemies in a row without dying will reward you and your team with a pack of vicious Dogs.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG26: Do you have Friends on the Lone Wolves list? Invite them all to your squad by clicking 'Invite Friends'.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG27: When you fire a weapon with a Suppressor or Flash Hider, you do not appear as a red dot on the enemies compass or in-game map.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG28: The Camouflage perk will prevent you from showing up as a red dot when an enemy Recon Plane is flying above.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG29: Maximum level is not the end of your career; you then have the option to gain Prestige.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG30: You can customize the game rules when you host an online or LAN match.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG31: Experience points (XP) can only be gained in online matches.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG32: In the Domination and War game modes, multiple teammates will capture a flag faster.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG33: Press the V key (default) to perform a knife melee attack.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG34: Pressing the shift key (default) allows you to sprint, however you cannot use your weapons while sprinting.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG35: When zoomed in with a scoped weapon, holding down the shift key (default) allows you to hold your breath, and steady your aim.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG36: If a frag grenade lands near you look for the throwback indicator. This will allow you to send the enemy grenade back using the G key or middle mouse wheel.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG37: Weapons can shoot through many different surfaces with reduced damage.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG38: Rifle Grenades, Bazookas, Bouncing Betty's and Satchel Charges are stored in your inventory.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG39: Satchel Charges can be thrown with the right mouse button and detonated with the left mouse button.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.PLATFORM_DYK_MSG40: By double tapping the use key you can detonate thrown Satchel Charges when you are using your primary / secondary weapon.

localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_04_LEVEL_03_DESC: Use a sniper rifle to support the defense of City Hall.

localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_06_LEVEL_01_DESC: Withdraw from Toujane in a captured armored car.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_06_LEVEL_02_DESC: Drive the Afrika Korps out of the town of Toujane.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_06_LEVEL_03_DESC: Secure the Matmata route to Tunis, and shoot down enemy planes using an anti-aircraft gun.

localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_NMISSION_07_LEVEL_02_DESC: Repel a major counterattack at Pointe du Hoc.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_07_LEVEL_03_DESC: Capture the village, then snipe enemy mortar teams from the top of the destroyed silo during the counterattack.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_01_DESC: Reconnoiter the town of Beltot and then obtain a truck to transport wounded Americans.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_02_DESC: Secure the crossroads at Anctoville and neutralize a German wireless station.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_03_DESC: Capture the town hall, church, post office, and German field HQ in the town of St. Louet.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_08_LEVEL_04_DESC: Capture a German field HQ, then repel the enemy counterattacks.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_09_LEVEL_01_DESC: Clear the town at the foot of Hill 400, room by room, house by house.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_09_LEVEL_02_DESC: Fight your way to the top and eliminate the German forces holding the hill.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_09_LEVEL_03_DESC: Repel multiple counterattacks at the top of Hill 400 until friendly forces arrive.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MENU_MISSION_10_LEVEL_01_DESC: Capture the German town of Wallendar and secure a crossing point on the Rhine River for the Allies.

localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MPUI_BOLT_ACTION_RIFLES_DESC: Bolt Action Rifles are sturdy, reliable, and deadly accurate from long range. What they lack in fire rate they make up for in power.

localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MPUI_SHOTGUNS_DESC: Shotguns are designed for close range combat and excel at just that. Although they have a low ammo count and a slow rate of fire, they are extremely deadly at close range.
localized_code_post_gfx_mp.MPUI_LIGHT_MACHINE_GUNS_DESC: Light machine guns come equipped with better accuracy, but smaller ammo count. While less mobile and accurate, heavy machine guns have a large ammo count and a faster rate of fire. Both are very dangerous at medium to long range.

localized_common_mp.PATCH_AMERICAN_HERO_DESC:
Tank Dempsey: American hero. Hand him a loaded weapon, a good woman, and something to shoot at and he is happy. Enrage him and he will rip your guts out and use them as a bandolier. 
...
Dempsey was selected for this mission after he showed his true grit at the battle for Peleliu. Remarkable though it may seem, his unit was captured during the early raids before the main invasion, and he spent 2 weeks in a rat infested bamboo cage submerged in malarial water. Well that did not stop The Tank. After he gnawed his way through the cage, he then gnawed his way through his captors armed only with a Bobby pin and his Medal of Honor which he keeps secreted in various body cavities. 
...
Now you know there is no before the war for Dempsey, and there is no after. There is only the legend of Tank Dempsey, and how he will win the war for the rest of us.
localized_common_mp.PATCH_RUSSIAN_HERO_DESC:
Stalin himself cannot stare Nikolai in the eye, no one can. There, in his eyes, you will see the soul of a man burning with the hatred of all things living. His closet is full of skeletons, many of them with the flesh still attached. 
...
Early in his career, Nikolai had quickly made his way up through the party ranks by killing the next man in line, and by marrying politically. Ultimately, his aspirations all came crashing down after his fifth wife mysteriously died while cleaning his axe with her neck. Little did he know that she had been sleeping with a high ranking party official on the side. This made Nikolai infamous, and his reputation spread quickly through the party. It was not long before Stalin himself had heard about Nikolai. More importantly, he feared Nikolai. As soon as the war started, our hero was dropped on the front lines and forgotten about, where he wallowed in self pity and Vodka for several years.  
...
There are many weapons in his arsenal, not least of which is his breath.
localized_common_mp.PATCH_JAPANESE_HERO_DESC:
Enter Takeo, for whom life has no meaning if not to perfect your discipline and to reveal true character and honor. Perhaps he ponders this and other philosophical questions as his Katana slices through the flesh and sinew of his enemy. 
...
Our hero was born into wealth; his family dynasty dates back several centuries, and throughout that time they have been highly decorated Samurai and Bushi. Well Takeo is no exception to this celebrated bloodline. Even when the family first saw the young, life-filled 5 year old Takeo playing in the street with his Katana and slicing the tails off terrified kittens, it was obvious he was destined to bring honor to the Masaki name. 
...
Reserved and reflective, the war is a perfect opportunity for Takeo to explore his bloodlust and study the nature of those less honorable than himself, so if you fall victim to his swift action and might know that you have helped a man better than you reach enlightenment.
localized_common_mp.PATCH_GERMAN_HERO_DESC:
"Beware The Doc". A message that was scrawled across walls of every town under Axis control. Starvation may cripple you, dysentery may wreck you, and gunfire may rip the flesh from your bones, but "Beware The Doc".

...
This is Dr. Richtofen, known affectionately as The Butcher to his victims as they scream in agony moments before he snuffs out their light. All through his career, Richtofen has been at the forefront of torture and information extraction research. Richtofen is an incurable sociopath and sees no moral distinction between natural death and murder; the victim is the victim, regardless of how their demise manifests itself. 
...
Doctor Richtofen has a collection of stuffed animals, most of them posed in positions of terror at the instant of their death.

patch.PATCH_AMERICAN_HERO_DESC:
Tank Dempsey: American hero. Hand him a loaded weapon, a good woman, and something to shoot at and he is happy. Enrage him and he will rip your guts out and use them as a bandolier. 
...
Dempsey was selected for this mission after he showed his true grit at the battle for Peleliu. Remarkable though it may seem, his unit was captured during the early raids before the main invasion, and he spent 2 weeks in a rat infested bamboo cage submerged in malarial water. Well that did not stop The Tank. After he gnawed his way through the cage, he then gnawed his way through his captors armed only with a Bobby pin and his Medal of Honor which he keeps secreted in various body cavities. 
...
Now you know there is no before the war for Dempsey, and there is no after. There is only the legend of Tank Dempsey, and how he will win the war for the rest of us.
patch.PATCH_RUSSIAN_HERO_DESC:
Stalin himself cannot stare Nikolai in the eye, no one can. There, in his eyes, you will see the soul of a man burning with the hatred of all things living. His closet is full of skeletons, many of them with the flesh still attached. 
...
Early in his career, Nikolai had quickly made his way up through the party ranks by killing the next man in line, and by marrying politically. Ultimately, his aspirations all came crashing down after his fifth wife mysteriously died while cleaning his axe with her neck. Little did he know that she had been sleeping with a high ranking party official on the side. This made Nikolai infamous, and his reputation spread quickly through the party. It was not long before Stalin himself had heard about Nikolai. More importantly, he feared Nikolai. As soon as the war started, our hero was dropped on the front lines and forgotten about, where he wallowed in self pity and Vodka for several years.  
...
There are many weapons in his arsenal, not least of which is his breath.
patch.PATCH_JAPANESE_HERO_DESC:
Enter Takeo, for whom life has no meaning if not to perfect your discipline and to reveal true character and honor. Perhaps he ponders this and other philosophical questions as his Katana slices through the flesh and sinew of his enemy. 
...
Our hero was born into wealth; his family dynasty dates back several centuries, and throughout that time they have been highly decorated Samurai and Bushi. Well Takeo is no exception to this celebrated bloodline. Even when the family first saw the young, life-filled 5 year old Takeo playing in the street with his Katana and slicing the tails off terrified kittens, it was obvious he was destined to bring honor to the Masaki name. 
...
Reserved and reflective, the war is a perfect opportunity for Takeo to explore his bloodlust and study the nature of those less honorable than himself, so if you fall victim to his swift action and might know that you have helped a man better than you reach enlightenment.
patch.PATCH_GERMAN_HERO_DESC:
"Beware The Doc". A message that was scrawled across walls of every town under Axis control. Starvation may cripple you, dysentery may wreck you, and gunfire may rip the flesh from your bones, but "Beware The Doc".

...
This is Dr. Richtofen, known affectionately as The Butcher to his victims as they scream in agony moments before he snuffs out their light. All through his career, Richtofen has been at the forefront of torture and information extraction research. Richtofen is an incurable sociopath and sees no moral distinction between natural death and murder; the victim is the victim, regardless of how their demise manifests itself. 
...
Doctor Richtofen has a collection of stuffed animals, most of them posed in positions of terror at the instant of their death.

ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_HARDCORE_CHEAT_DESC: You've defeated the entire Nazi empire at the Reichstag. Now go back and do it again with the merciless nature of real war. Limit your HUD, turn on friendly fire, and bleed out in half the time.
ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_DIRTYHARRY_CHEAT_DESC: Go down fighting. Fire explosive pistol rounds while downed.
ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_STICKSSTONES_CHEAT_DESC: Hope you've got a strong arm. Your weapon arsenal consists of a knife and a bunch of rocks.
ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_MORPHINE_SHOT_CHEAT_DES: Make your weapon useful for a change. Shoot downed co-op teammates to revive them.
ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_VAMPIRE_CHEAT_DESC: Steal life from your prey. Only recharge your health by getting kills.
ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_BODY_ARMOR_CHEAT_DESC: Hone your accuracy. Enemies die by headshot only.
ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_HARD_HEADED_CHEAT_DESC: Keep your finger on the trigger. Enemies take less bullet damage.
ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_DEAD_HANDS_CHEAT_DESC: Save your brass. Enemies take their weapons with them to the grave.
ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_FLAK_JACKET_CHEAT_DESC: No more easy grenade kills. Enemies take less explosive damage.
ui.MENU_HOST_OPTION_PAINTBALL_CHEAT_DESC: Can't handle the brutality of war? Try paintball guns.

ui.MPUI_BOLT_ACTION_RIFLES_DESC: Bolt Action Rifles are sturdy, reliable, and deadly accurate from long range. What they lack in fire rate they make up for in power.
ui.MPUI_RIFLES_DESC: Semi-automatic rifles fire one bullet at a time, but can be fired as fast as you can squeeze the trigger. Fully-automatic rifles fire until the trigger is released. Both are good at medium range and are fairly accurate.
ui.MPUI_SUB_MACHINE_GUNS_DESC: Submachine Guns are shoulder-fired weapons that have a high rate of fire, while still packing a punch in terms of power. Ideal for close to medium range combat.
ui.MPUI_SHOTGUNS_DESC: Shotguns are designed for close range combat and excel at just that. Although they have a low ammo count and a slow rate of fire, they are extremely deadly at close range.
ui.MPUI_LIGHT_MACHINE_GUNS_DESC: Light machine guns come equipped with better accuracy, but smaller ammo count. While less mobile and accurate, heavy machine guns have a large ammo count and a faster rate of fire. Both are very dangerous at medium to long range.
